name: thingsboard-rpc-r0
notes: Release 077 (experiment TB): the call shape the ThingsBoard owner gateway (conformance/reference/tb_owner_gateway.py) uses in the campaign: persistent two-way RPC as thingsboard-rpc, but without platform retries (retries 0), so that ThingsBoard never delivers an RPC to the device more than once on its own (the adapter premise DRIVER_NO_DUPLICATE_EFFECT). Same probes, parameters and repetitions as thingsboard-rpc. Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure thingsboard.
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
